title: Jewish Aramaic Curse Texts from Late-Antique Mesopotamia: ‘May These Curses Go Out and Flee’
container_title: Magical and Religious Literature of Late Antiquity 2
citation: Levene, Dan. Jewish Aramaic Curse Texts from Late-Antique Mesopotamia: ‘May These Curses Go Out and Flee.’ Magical and Religious Literature of Late Antiquity 2. Leiden and Boston: Brill, 2013.
notes: Complete 178-page researcher-supplied edition held in the private archive, SHA-256 d4b2c6e2946e10ab295d5b45a7ce2b132b674e35da40c09e1818a8af53d92a3d. It newly edits fourteen physical bowls in thirteen grouped entries and revisits sixteen previously published bowls with texts, translations, commentary, and photographs. Copyrighted text and images are not cleared for public release.

title: Jewish Love Magic: From Late Antiquity to the Middle Ages

title: Marco Moriggi, Siam Bhayro (eds.). Studies in the Syriac Magical Traditions
publisher: CNRS / Association pour l’avancement des études iraniennes
citation: Jullien, Christelle. ‘Marco Moriggi, Siam Bhayro (eds.). Studies in the Syriac Magical Traditions.’ Abstracta Iranica 44 (2022), document 32.
notes: The supplied file is the complete three-page review, not the reviewed 2021 Brill volume. Researcher-supplied review held in the private archive, SHA-256 2832a9bfc1d27f920374e484c0d112849a3ebd6a64bc06c189ad6895db6337eb. title: Amulets and Magic Bowls: Aramaic Incantations of Late Antiquity
publisher: The Magnes Press; E. J. Brill
citation: Naveh, Joseph, and Shaul Shaked. Amulets and Magic Bowls: Aramaic Incantations of Late Antiquity. Jerusalem: The Magnes Press; Leiden: E. J. Brill, 1985.
notes: Complete 336-page researcher-supplied scan of the 1985 first edition held in the private archive, SHA-256 545d89c8de51dee8871cf4bf48b18202ea57cbe023b745cedbf997f6da07548b. It includes fourteen physical incantation bowls under thirteen numbered text entries, plus amulets and Geniza materials, with translations, commentary, photographs, and drawings. Kept distinct from the existing 1987 and 1998 bibliographic records. Copyrighted text and images are not cleared for public release.
